analysis_rule: Compute independent high-pivot row bases for pair sums and curve controls, then insert the control basis into a copy of the pair basis. Backsolve the pair row basis in ascending pivot order to construct its right nullspace; choose the minimum-weight basis relation that is nonzero on at least one control row. Preserve its exact monomial indices for exhaustive checking.
claim_boundary: Finite-sample rank and an explicitly extracted quadratic equality for the frozen N41 pair domains; exact support validity requires the subsequent exhaustive check.
